subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Which Android chat message action scope should this issue use before a same-repo fix is adopted or queued?
rationale: Copy and selective copy are directly requested usability fixes, but Share and Reply add broader interaction semantics and the linked implementation path is currently a conflicting cross-repo PR.

options.title: Approve Copy and Select Copy first
options.body: Implement a narrow long-press action surface for whole-message copy and selective copy, and leave Share/Reply for later issues if wanted.

options.title: Approve the full four-action sheet
options.body: Include Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply now, but require a clear reply-context contract and Android proof before merge.

options.title: Keep as maintainer-sponsored only
options.body: Leave this open as a product backlog item and do not queue automated implementation until an Android owner sponsors the exact behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve Copy and Select Copy first
recommendation.body: Implement a narrow long-press action surface for whole-message copy and selective copy, and leave Share/Reply for later issues if wanted.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has recent adjacent Android chat maintenance history and is already in the issue timeline, making him the best available routing owner for the product-scope choice.
